name: gorgias
description: Reads and safely plans documented Gorgias REST API operations through connector-owned streams, bounded direct reads, and approval-gated reverse ETL actions.

risk.read: external Gorgias API reads for helpdesk, account, customer, ticket, event, phone, automation, and configuration records
risk.write: approval-gated reverse ETL mutations and provider-side POST computations for documented create, update, merge, delete, admin, and statistic retrieval actions
risk.approval: all write actions use reverse ETL plan -> preview -> explicit approval -> execute; destructive actions additionally require typed confirmation
